ABOUT US

“Your jewelry introduces you before you even speak.”

Laconic by definition means using or involving the use of a minimum of words. At LACONIC, we believe fine jewellery is for the every day, not just a single occasion. LACONIC’s ultramodern designs are meant to make a statement, celebrate your style, and inspire and elevate your confidence.

OUR PRODUCTS

At LACONIC, we work diligently with our manufacturing partners and jewellers to source and create quality pieces using the finest materials. We are committed to sustainability, both in our manufacturing process and quality. In doing so, we create pieces that last, limiting unnecessary repurchases or consumption that's good for your wallet and friendly to our planet. Besides our jewellery, our packaging is made using recycled cardboard to reduce our carbon footprint.

OUR ETHOS

ELEVATED QUALITY

LACONIC jewellery is made using the finest material for everyday wear, with ease. Our demi-fine jewellery is made of 925 sterling silver with a thick layer of 14k recycled gold while our gold pieces are made in 10k & 14k recycled gold. We also specialize in custom jewellery; contact us at customercare@laconicjewellery.com to begin designing your custom piece.

MODERN DESIGNS

Elevate your confidence and style with ultramodern jewellery for the everyday you. All of our contemporary inspired exclusive LACONIC pieces are carefully designed by our Co-Founders with the intention to exude luxury, transcend time, and become a treasured heirloom.

SUSTAINABLE CONSUMPTION 

Investing in timeless luxury gold jewellery for everyday wear ensures you purchase less, for more. LACONIC pieces are made to last and pass down to those you cherish the most, limiting unnecessary repurchases or consumption that's good for your wallet and friendly to our planet. In addition to our jewellery, our packaging is made using recycled cardboard to reduce our carbon footprint. LACONIC is a proud partner with Planet to offer carbon-neutral shipping. 

OUR AFFILIATE PROGRAMS

You will receive a quarterly PR package of LACONIC jewellery. You will receive 5% commission on total referral sales when a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or use of your coupon code. Your commission will be payable monthly, by the 15th of every month by e-transfer. 

Our affiliate programs renew every 6 months. Confirmation of continued partnership will be completed before the end of the 6 months unless specified otherwise.
